title: Security & Supply Chain Engine
objective: Add zero-cost, pinned, risk-proportional security and supply-chain controls without weakening runtime safety or turning every routine change into a full security certification.

tasks.description: Implement secret controls with a pinned zero-cost Gitleaks integration and adversarial qualification.
Implement dependency vulnerability and dependency-diff controls.
Implement SAST with audited pinned tools.
Implement GitHub Actions syntax and security controls.
Implement supply-chain pinning and third-party action verification.
Minimize permissions and remediate repository protection gaps where accessible.
Verify the security engine remains zero-cost and risk-proportional.

done_when: secret controls detect current and newly introduced hardcoded secrets with redacted output
dependency changes and known vulnerabilities receive bounded automated checks
SAST and workflow-security controls are pinned and selectively executed
third-party actions and supply-chain dependencies are explicitly pinned and audited
mandatory path requires no paid API SaaS LLM or larger runner
sensitive changes cannot bypass T3 assurance while routine low-risk changes avoid unnecessary deep scans
